static.note: A painted village with a HUD and a score line the game does not have. The drift is known, recorded in qa/thumbnails.mjs, and accepted — this baseline exists so the NEXT drift is not.

windup.note: Baseline only: recorded as the game stood at #132, not compared against the card by eye.

lantern-keeper.note: Looked at beside the game at #172. Same place: a layered forest, mossy stone with a grass cap, warm light round a lit lantern. Accepted drift: the game is darker overall; the card's score, lives, stage and health line are not in the game; and the keeper, lanterns, ladder and sign are still the old art until #173.

pocket-dungeon.note: Baseline only: recorded as the game stood at #132, not compared against the card by eye. Its DMG art was unreachable when this was recorded; #134 wired the palette toggle, so the hashed art is now art a player can actually see.
